description: This file contains a partial struct 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' with methods for writing variable-length encoded integers (varints) of various types, including sbyte, short, int, long, byte, and ushort. It also includes internal static methods for ZigZag encoding of int and long values, which are used to efficiently encode signed integers as unsigned varints.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A partial struct providing methods for writing variable-length encoded integers to a buffer.

methods.name: WriteVarInt8
methods.description: Writes a variable-width sbyte using ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarInt16
methods.description: Writes a variable-width short using ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarInt32
methods.description: Writes a variable-width int using ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: WriteVarInt64
methods.description: Writes a variable-width long using ZigZag encoding.

methods.name: ZigZagEncode
methods.description: Encodes an int or long using ZigZag encoding for efficient varint representation.
